# GIPS PROJECT

> GIPS PROJECT provides drywall, plasterboard and finishing work in Podgorica and throughout Montenegro. The website is available in Serbian Latin and English.

## Services

- Suspended plasterboard ceilings, including stepped and decorative designs.
- Metal-framed drywall partition walls.
- Plasterboard wall lining (locally called regips or gips-karton).
- Decorative plasterwork: niches, shelves, TV walls, arches and curved features.
- Thermal and sound insulation within drywall systems.
- Joint finishing, skim coating and painting.

## Estimates and availability

Estimates are free. Customers should provide the location, approximate dimensions, photographs and intended work. Prices, travel arrangements, availability and timelines are confirmed for each project. No fixed per-square-metre prices are published. The website does not publish a street address or opening hours.
